e.title: insurance-causal
e.summary: 因果推断定价（burning-cost，MIT）：Double ML 价格弹性/费率变更评估
e.body: insurance-causal（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）用 Double Machine Learning 做保险定价的因果推断：价格弹性（price elasticity）、车联网效应、费率变更的事后评估——从观测数据估计因果效应。对 RIAA：定价方法的前沿——从相关性到因果性（「费率涨 5% 会流失多少客户」）；与 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（预测方法）互补：预测 vs 因果决策；配 [[insurance-deploy]]（champion/challenger）做费率变更评估的工程闭环；「因果推断 × 精算定价」的课程/论文方向。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：burning-cost 仓库 + PyPI 确认（DML 因果定价，MIT，测试通过），未实测
e.summary_en: Causal-inference pricing (burning-cost, MIT): double-ML price elasticity / rate-change evaluation
e.summary_hk: 因果推斷定價（burning-cost，MIT）：Double ML 價格彈性/費率變更評估
e.body_en: insurance-causal (burning-cost, PyPI, MIT) applies Double Machine Learning to causal inference in insurance pricing: price elasticity, telematics effects and post-hoc rate-change evaluation — estimating causal effects from observational data. For RIAA: the frontier of pricing methods — from correlation to causality ('how many customers will a 5% rate rise lose'); complementing [[machine-learning-pricing]] (predictive methods): prediction vs causal decision; with [[insurance-deploy]] (champion/challenger) it closes the engineering loop of rate-change evaluation; a course/thesis direction of causal inference × actuarial pricing.
e.body_hk: insurance-causal（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）用 Double Machine Learning 做保險定價的因果推斷：價格彈性（price elasticity）、車聯網效應、費率變更的事後評估——從觀測數據估計因果效應。對 RIAA：定價方法的前沿——從相關性到因果性（「費率漲 5% 會流失多少客户」）；與 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（預測方法）互補：預測 vs 因果決策；配 [[insurance-deploy]]（champion/challenger）做費率變更評估的工程閉環；「因果推斷 × 精算定價」的課程/論文方向。
